findings.claim: Immediate selection evidence and descendant credit disagree in kind and cannot be pooled. Endpoint (selection) contrasts are strong and coherent for pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5/5.0 (endpoint_effects:9-12, positive_batch_fraction 1.0/1.0/1.0/0.857, q<=0.0037) and for landmark_00_occupancy3 (endpoint_effects:15, q=2.4e-4), while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (endpoint_effects:13, q=1.5e-4). Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity: decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false, and the only survival fields reaching nominal significance (survival_effects:0,70,100,186) are weak (|z|<=0.37) with q>=0.12 after BH over 400 tests. Because terminal labels are unavailable, last-record survival credit must not be presented as final affinity benefit; the selection-vs-survival comparison is unavailable and direction priorities should follow the selection contrasts, not the survival credit.

Uncertainty and multiplicity change the ranking relative to point estimates. Under raw_covariance the largest whole_window_mean magnitudes are global_centroid_y (3.70e-6, branch_adjusted:1) and global_centroid_z (4.14e-7, branch_adjusted:2), but their CIs cross zero (q=0.69, 0.97) and same_sign_batch_fraction is only 0.43/0.36. The features that survive multiplicity adjustment are pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 (adjusted_covariance q=0.081/0.077, same-sign batch fraction 0.79, branch_adjusted:86-87; adjusted_correlation q=0.019/0.046, same-sign 0.93, branch_adjusted:240-241) and the joint motion diagnostics joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A (adjusted_covariance q=0.020/0.030, same-sign 0.93, branch_adjusted:151,153; adjusted_correlation q=2.8e-4/9.7e-4, same-sign 0.93/1.0, branch_adjusted:305,307). A concrete priority decision that differs from point-estimate ranking: rank pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 and joint_innovation/joint_internal above global_centroid_y/z, even though the centroid means are numerically larger.

Independent-batch agreement and opposing observations constrain the coordinate rule. pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 have same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93 (adjusted_correlation) and 0.79 (adjusted_covariance) across 14 independent batches, and joint_innovation_RMS_A/joint_internal_RMS_A have 0.93/1.0, so these directions are reproducible. The counterexample that would weaken them is a batch subset with reversed sign: shape_yy is the clearest opposing observation (adjusted_correlation -0.100, same-sign 1.0, q=2.9e-4, branch_adjusted:235; raw_correlation -0.103, branch_adjusted:158), and the joint diagnostics are negative in sign (branch_adjusted:228,230,305,307), so a rule that treats 'larger pair-kernel density' and 'smaller joint innovation/internal RMS' as the same favorable axis is not supported; the two families must be carried as separate signed directions.

Local coordinate information is separable from global pose and shape only through the supplied adjusted diagnostics. The adjusted_covariance/adjusted_correlation rows for global_centroid_x/y/z (branch_adjusted:77-79, 231-233) and for the shape_xx..shape_yz block (branch_adjusted:80-85, 234-239) are all null (q>=0.13), whereas joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A remain significant after adjustment (branch_adjusted:151,153,305,307). This is the supplied adjustment, not a rigid-motion residual computed here: the region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals. The extent that should retain freedom is the global centroid and the six shape components (the whole-molecule pose/shape block), while the joint innovation/internal RMS contrast is the part that adds information beyond common motion.

Coherent joint coordinate patterns are distinguishable from isolated marginal descriptors. Within-selector, innovation_native_alignment (joint_diagnostics:1, mean 0.092, q=2.2e-9) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (joint_diagnostics:11, mean 0.226, q=2.2e-9) are the only tested joint associations that survive; observed_child_score_gain is significantly negative (joint_diagnostics:2, mean -0.036, q=1.8e-7). The untested descriptive fractions show the contrast is dominated by internal motion (teacher_contrast_internal_fraction 0.787, joint_diagnostics:14) with smaller translation (0.132, joint_diagnostics:12) and rotation (0.081, joint_diagnostics:13) fractions, and atom participation 0.384 (joint_diagnostics:15). These are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit, so they identify coupling/redundancy structure but do not license averaging incompatible conformations into a single target.

The supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over the complete observed support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed=false for every row, and the curve_support audit rejects all 24 candidate curves (selected_count 24 under the strict rule relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1; e.g. landmark_16_occupancy5 relative_node_rmse 0.931 with 15 strong sign-conflict nodes). Every soft_mass curve shows sign changes (4-10 per curve) and large first/last rate_z magnitudes (e.g. continuous:0 first_rate_z 9.27, last_rate_z -10.00; continuous:100 first_rate_z 66.3, last_rate_z -11.6), so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule would require validated fits that the audit does not provide. No arbitrary time bins or extrapolation are used, and a contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

Population-contrast changes and parent-child increment contrasts separate within-path change from changing cohort composition. For landmark_00_soft_mass the population_rate is small and non-significant (turnover:0, mean_rate_z 0.185, p=0.72) while edge_rate is large (turnover:1, 4.55, p=0.034) and the turnover_residual_rate is large and negative (turnover:2, -4.36, p=0.034), i.e. the population change is not explained by within-path parent-child increments alone. The same pattern recurs for landmark_00_local_cxx (turnover:14, residual 4.29, p=0.0021), landmark_00_local_cyy (turnover:17, 5.05, p=0.0015), landmark_01_local_cyy (turnover:47, 6.40, p=4.3e-4), landmark_04_local_cxx (turnover:134, 5.67, p=2.5e-5), landmark_07_local_cxx (turnover:224, 5.08, p=1.1e-4), landmark_08_local_cxx (turnover:254, 5.54, p=1.2e-4), landmark_16_local_cyy (turnover:497, 6.37, p=1.2e-4), landmark_17_local_cxx (turnover:524, 5.24, p=4.1e-5), landmark_19_local_cxx (turnover:584, 5.30, p=2.3e-4) and landmark_19_local_cyy (turnover:587, 5.37, p=0.0012). The residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity, so the evidence supports changing cohort composition alongside within-path change rather than within-path change alone.

Regional enrichment and its change rate are not interchangeable. Enrichment_z is positive and significant for soft_mass at landmarks 00, 07, 10, 14, 17, 18 (regional_effects:0,70,100,140,170,180) and for local_dy at landmarks 02, 06, 09, 14, 18 (regional_effects:22,62,92,142,182), while the corresponding enrichment_change_rate_z is mostly null. The parent_edge_contrast_rate_z is strongly negative for local_cxx and local_cyy at nearly every landmark (e.g. regional_effects:404,405,474,475,484,485,494,495,524,525,534,535,544,545,554,555,564,565,574,575,583,584,585,594,595), with the largest negative values at landmarks 16 (local_cyy -5.90, regional_effects:565) and 19 (local_cxx -4.82, regional_effects:594). These are separate measures with different signs, so a single 'favorable region' axis cannot be assembled from them.

The information audit bounds what the coordinate evidence can support. The compressed-choice excess fixed-RMS is 0.081 A (CI95 0.070-0.092) and the compressed chosen teacher score correlation is 0.102 (CI95 0.065-0.140), with top4 teacher overlap 0.470; the audit states this is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, that nonnegative excess distance is by construction and not a causal affinity effect, and that teacher score correlations are observational and not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor. Teacher modes are static (28 teachers, assignment RMS quantiles 0.446/0.863/1.050 A) and temperature_edits is false. The learning window is [0.0,0.5] with observed score times 0.0-0.49, so no current-study outcome is available to either role.

Parent-child increment contrasts are sparse and mostly null, which limits any within-path claim. landmark_00_softmin is negative (increment_effects:14, -4.91, q=0.046) and landmark_00_occupancy3 positive (increment_effects:15, 4.28, q=0.081), pair_kernel_2.5 positive (increment_effects:10, 3.96, q=0.208) and pair_kernel_7.0 negative (increment_effects:13, -3.14, q=0.208), while shape_xx/shape_yy are negative (increment_effects:3,4, q=0.095/0.161) and shape_xz positive (increment_effects:7, 3.00, q=0.207). Most landmark occupancy and softmin increments have q>0.2 (e.g. increment_effects:23,25,34,53,55,63,70), so the increment evidence alone does not establish a within-path direction.

A testable coordinate intervention can be expressed only through the permitted reward recipes. Observable: the endpoint pointcloud contrast on pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 (endpoint_effects:9,10) and on landmark_00_occupancy3 (endpoint_effects:15), with the joint innovation/internal RMS contrast (branch_adjusted:151,153,305,307) as the pose/shape-side observable. Intended response: increase pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 shell density and landmark_00_occupancy3 while decreasing joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A. Target origin: the supplied landmark coordinates (landmarks_A) and the endpoint pointcloud scalar. Spatial scale: pair-kernel shells at 1.5 and 2.5 A and the landmark_00 region; temporal scale: the observed support [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation. Discriminating failure condition: if the pair-kernel endpoint contrast reverses sign in a held-out batch subset, or if the joint innovation/internal RMS contrast does not move opposite to the pair-kernel contrast, the hypothesis fails. The permitted recipe that could express this is the endpoint pointcloud reward with a region/teacher-neighbor selection; the temporal_teacher blend is not supported because the curve_support audit rejects all 24 candidate curves and no validated time-conditioned fit exists, so the temporal form remains descriptive.

hypotheses.claim: Hypothesis H1: a coordinate intervention that increases pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 shell density (endpoint_effects:9,10; adjusted q=0.081/0.077 and 0.019/0.046) will raise the endpoint pointcloud contrast. Observable: pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 endpoint contrast. Intended response: positive. Target origin: endpoint pointcloud scalar. Spatial scale: 1.5-2.5 A pair shells. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure: sign reversal in a held-out batch subset.

Hypothesis H2: decreasing joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A (adjusted q=0.020/0.030 and 2.8e-4/9.7e-4, same-sign 0.93/1.0) is a separate favorable direction from H1 and should be carried as its own signed axis. Observable: joint innovation/internal RMS contrast. Intended response: negative. Target origin: endpoint pointcloud scalar. Spatial scale: whole-molecule pose/shape block. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure: the joint contrast moving in the same direction as the pair-kernel contrast.

Hypothesis H3: landmark occupancy3/occupancy5 and softmin contrasts are not a single favorable axis. landmark_00_occupancy3 is positive (endpoint_effects:15, q=2.4e-4) while landmark_00_softmin is negative (endpoint_effects:14, q=8.1e-4), and landmark_02_softmin is positive (endpoint_effects:20, q=0.0046) while landmark_02_occupancy5 is negative (endpoint_effects:22, q=0.0026). Observable: per-landmark occupancy/softmin endpoint contrasts. Intended response: landmark-specific sign. Target origin: endpoint pointcloud scalar. Spatial scale: individual landmark regions. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure: a single global sign fitting all landmarks.

Hypothesis H4: the large turnover_residual_rate values (e.g. turnover:2,14,17,47,134,224,254,497,524,584,587) indicate that population-contrast changes are driven substantially by changing cohort composition and score reclassification rather than within-path parent-child increments. Observable: turnover residual rate. Intended response: not a causal selection effect. Target origin: accounting diagnostic. Spatial scale: per-landmark local moments. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure: residual shrinking to zero when parent weighting is held fixed.

Hypothesis H5: no validated time-conditioned contrast rule is available. All 24 candidate curves fail the curve_support fidelity rule (relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1) and every continuous row has extrapolation_allowed=false with 3-13 sign changes. Observable: curve fidelity audit. Intended response: none. Target origin: observed-node interpolation. Spatial scale: per-feature. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure: a curve passing the audit with zero strong sign-conflict nodes.

Hypothesis H6: the teacher-based coordinate signal is observational and weak. The compressed chosen teacher score correlation is 0.102 (CI95 0.065-0.140) and the audit states it is not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor; the only surviving joint associations are innovation_native_alignment (joint_diagnostics:1) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (joint_diagnostics:11), with observed_child_score_gain negative (joint_diagnostics:2). Observable: teacher score correlation and joint alignment. Intended response: descriptive only. Target origin: static teacher coordinates. Spatial scale: whole-molecule. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure: an independently validated affinity predictor contradicting the observational correlation.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false, so the selection-vs-survival comparison is unavailable.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling; it is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals, and no rigid-motion residual was computed here.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis were used, and all 24 candidate curves fail the supplied fidelity audit.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures; teacher score correlations are observational and not a validated affinity predictor.
All weak and null scalar effects are retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles, and no temperature edit is proposed.
